Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_031139.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_031139.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_031139 (
    input [31:0] addr,
    output reg [31:0] dataout,
    input [31:0] datain,
    input rdclk,
    input wrclk,
    input [2:0] memop,
    input we
);

  wire [31:0] q;
  reg [3:0] byteena_a, byteena_a_t;
  reg [31:0] datain_t;

  dmem my_mem (
      .byteena_a(byteena_a),
      .data(datain_t),
      .rdaddress(addr[16:2]),
      .rdclock(rdclk),
      .wraddress(addr[16:2]),
      .wrclock(wrclk),
      .wren(we),
      .q(q)
  );

  always @(*) begin
    if (we) begin
      case (memop[1:0])
        2'b00:   byteena_a_t = 4'b0001;
        2'b01:   byteena_a_t = 4'b0011;
        2'b10:   byteena_a_t = 4'b1111;
        default: byteena_a_t = 4'b0000;
      endcase
      case (addr[1:0])
        2'b00: begin
          datain_t  = datain;
          byteena_a = byteena_a_t;
        end
        2'b01: begin
          datain_t  = {datain[23:0], 8'b0};
          byteena_a = {byteena_a_t[2:0], 1'b0};
        end
        2'b10: begin
          datain_t  = {datain[15:0], 16'b0};
          byteena_a = {byteena_a_t[1:0], 2'b0};
        end
        2'b11: begin
          datain_t  = {datain[7:0], 24'b0};
          byteena_a = {byteena_a_t[0], 3'b0};
        end
        default: begin
          datain_t  = 32'b0;
          byteena_a = 4'b0;
        end
      endcase
    end else begin
      byteena_a_t = 4'b0;
      byteena_a = 4'b0;
      datain_t = 32'b0;
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    case (memop)
      3'b000:
      case (addr[1:0])
        2'b00:   dataout = {{24{q[7]}}, q[7:0]};
        2'b01:   dataout = {{24{q[15]}}, q[15:8]};
        2'b10:   dataout = {{24{q[23]}}, q[23:16]};
        2'b11:   dataout = {{24{q[31]}}, q[31:24]};
        default: dataout = 32'b0;
      endcase
      3'b001:
      case (addr[1])
        1'b0: dataout = {{16{q[15]}}, q[15:0]};
        1'b1: dataout = {{16{q[31]}}, q[31:16]};
        default: dataout = 32'b0;
      endcase
      3'b010: dataout = q;
      3'b100:
      case (addr[1:0])
        2'b00:   dataout = {24'b0, q[7:0]};
        2'b01:   dataout = {24'b0, q[15:8]};
        2'b10:   dataout = {24'b0, q[23:16]};
        2'b11:   dataout = {24'b0, q[31:24]};
        default: dataout = 32'b0;
      endcase
      3'b101:
      case (addr[1])
        1'b0: dataout = {16'b0, q[15:0]};
        1'b1: dataout = {16'b0, q[31:16]};
        default: dataout = 32'b0;
      endcase
      default: dataout = 32'b0;
    endcase
  end

endmodule
